title: Coefficient square for the proper projection factor
statement: Fix a finite-field datum \(D\), its coefficient datum \(C\), a finite extension \(E/\mathbb Q_\ell\), \(n\ge1\), and a normalized six-functor operation datum \(S\) at \((E,n)\) [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Assume \(\ell\) is invertible in \(D.k\). Let \(o\) be simultaneous-system operations and \(z\) their specified realization data. Let \(f:X\to Y\) be a separated, locally finite-type, quasi-compact morphism of six-functor spaces, and fix a compactification \(c=(j:X\to\bar X,p:\bar X\to Y)\). Let \(K\) and \(L\) be bounded constructible derived-complete integral objects on \(X\) and \(Y\), with \(L\) of uniform finite-reduction Tor amplitude. Put \(A=S.\mathrm{higher}.\mathrm{integralExchange}(\mathrm{identitySquare}(f,c))\). Use sourceMap and targetMap of [def-sf-integral-projection-coordinate-data], first and second of [def-sf-integral-projection-factor-data], and middleMap, systemFirst and systemSecond of [def-sf-integral-projection-middle-map]. Write \(\alpha\gg\beta\) for first \(\alpha\), then \(\beta\). Then \(\mathrm{sourceMap}(K,L)\gg\mathrm{systemFirst}(\mathrm{red}(K),\mathrm{red}(L))=\mathrm{red}(\mathrm{first}(A,K,L))\gg\mathrm{middleMap}(K,L)\). Both sides end at \(p_*T_{\bar X}(j_!\mathrm{red}(K),p^*\mathrm{red}(L))\). This is the coefficient square for the proper projection mate alone; no open projection occurs.

source.place: Compactification-independence sentence: compatibility of individual refinement maps with counits and j_!, before the projection square is deduced. Integral-system realization steps 1 and 3 of lem-sf-integral-projection-refinement-square.

proof.text: Put M = A.stage.openExtension.obj K. Apply integralProjectionSupportFactorCoordinates to identify directReduction(M) followed by proper image of openReduction(K) with reduction of supportMap(K) followed by supportReduction(K). Naturality of the specified datumTensorReduction tensors this equation with the identity of L.

Curry the canonical tensor reduction natural isomorphisms. Transport ProperCoordinates.pullComparison along A.properPull, and transport the tensor comparisons along A.tensorBar and A.tensorY. integralTensorPullbackNormalization identifies A.stage.tensorPullback with ProperCoordinates.pullTensor on the proper factor. The existing integralProperTensorPullbackReduction gives ComparisonCompatible for these transported data after cancelling the inverse pull comparison.

Apply map_rightAdjointProjectionMap_comp_mateEquiv to the preceding tensor square. The counit formula for mateEquiv identifies its components with directReduction, since properPullReduction is exactly the transported pullComparison component. The tensor components are exactly barTensorReduction and datumTensorReduction, with the latter transported across A.tensorY. Cancel that tensor-source transport to obtain the proper projection coefficient square at arbitrary M. This is a private proved lemma, with no new obligation.

Specialize the proper square to M = A.stage.openExtension.obj K and paste it with the tensor of the support-coordinate equation. Naturality of the system proper projection moves proper image of openReduction across the proper projection. Bifunctoriality combines openReduction and properPullReduction to give middleMap. The inverse support identification tensored with identity cancels first; its reduction is an isomorphism, so cancelling it gives the stated equation.

lean.statement:
theorem integralProjectionProperFactorReduction
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
    (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left)
    (hL : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral C.l E Y.obj.left L.obj) :
    Coordinates.sourceMap D C E S.higher hl o z f c K L ≫
        ProjectionFactors.systemFirst D C E o f c
          ((calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reduction.obj K.obj)
          ((calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.obj L.obj) =
      (calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.map
        (ProjectionFactors.first (S.higher.integralExchange (identitySquare f c)) K L).hom ≫
          ProjectionFactors.middleMap D C E n hn S hl o z f c K L
